listing_info.description:
Wake up to panoramic Lake Winnipesaukee views from one of Samoset's most coveted lakefront townhomes. Fully renovated with designer finishes throughout, this 3BR + loft sleeps 10 (6 adults max) with unobstructed lake views from nearly every room.
Enjoy private beach access, water trampoline, tennis, pickleball, basketball, volleyball, and a fire pit in this resort-style community.
Note: pool construction summer 2026 — beach and all other amenities remain fully open.

The space
6 Adult Maximum. (Bunk beds seen in picture are for kids only).
The space is a 3BR, 2.5BA townhome w/ loft.
2 levels. Incredible direct lake views with very high end finishes and furniture.

Guest access
Entire Home
This stylish place to stay is perfect for large families

Sleeps 13-
There is nothing like island living, private and peaceful, 619' clean deep water frontage, 1.5 acres, on one of the most beautiful lakes in the world.

5 dock slips in a private protected cove. Circa 1800's oak post and beam, 3 floors, black walnut, cherry, mahogany and fir wood work, African granite counters, custom hand built kitchen, custom built cedar log entertainment system. Covered outdoor living area. The whole group will be comfortable in this spacious and unique space.

The space
Sleeps 13 -The main house is a restored 3 level post and beam, circa 1800's. On second level, there are two king bedrooms with a shared 3/4 bath. On the first floor, fully stocked custom made kitchen, large open living room with a 28' stone fireplace and 1/2 bath. Every window has a water view. Recently installed mini - splits for A/C or heat. Wood lovers will appreciate a display of black walnut, cherry, mahogany and fir throughout the main house.

The bunkhouse boasts custom built entertainment center, pool table, game table and 60" smart tv. There is a full bath with laundry on first floor, along with two private queen bedrooms each have sliders to access back deck. The 2nd level loft sleeps 8 (6 single bunk beds and 1 queen bed)

Between the main house and bunkhouse is a covered outdoor dining / sitting area, lake and water views all around.

Guests can enjoy 6 kayaks, fishing poles, corn hole, fire pit, and trails that explore through the island.

All guests need to have their own boat or rent a boat from a local marina. This property is NOT accessible by car.

Guest access
Our 1.5 acres with our private cove is all accessible to our guests

Other things to note
Guests can park overnight at Glendale Marina, 31 Dock Road, Gilford, NH. We provide overnight guest passes.

Beautiful four bedroom two bath home located on Balch Lake in West Newfield Maine. Two private docks and your own boat launch. Sandy beach area on the south side of the house receives lots of sunshine. Take out kayaks or pedal boat to explore Balch Lake! Updated kitchen and a magnificent view of the lake from the living room. Relax in the shade under 2 motor canopies on the deck off of the master bedroom. Enjoy a barbeque and go for a swim at this hidden gem.

Enjoy paradise at this 5-bedroom, 2-bathroom house on a beautiful lakefront lot directly on Lake Winnipesaukee. Situated on 'The Broads', the home boasts panoramic picturesque views of the largest open water on the big lake.

There is not a more attractive location than this perfect balance of privacy and convenience. Enjoy clear water swimming, fishing, walking, hiking or walk to Ellacoya State Park & Beach. Located in Gilford, minutes from Laconia, NH.

The space
Bright and sunny yet rustic newly renovated 5-bedroom home directly on Lake Winnipesaukee with room for 11 guests, this property is an ideal getaway. Situated on 'The Broads' section of the lake, the home boasts picturesque views of the big lake and mountains. The lake is perfect for swimming, with its sandy pebble bottom and crystal-clear water!

The home is located on a shared piece of property with our primary residence. We live in the home next door and share the waterfront and swimming area, we will not get in your way but you may see us outside on occasion.

The kitchen is fully-equipped with everything you need to make meals your whole group will love. Enjoy meals at the built-in eating counter or with a side of fresh air out on the patio. The view from here is so appealing it feels like you're floating above the water! 

Inside the Winnipesaukee home you'll find the front living room which provides 180-degree views of the lake and encompassing mountains. When you're not busy marveling at your gorgeous surroundings, relax and indulge in your favorite shows on the flat-screen streaming.  Central Air Conditioning will keep you cool on those hot summer days. Curl up on cooler nights with the gas heating stove while taking in the star filled night sky.

There are two comfortable living areas with ample seating, one with two couches pictured and a desk and office chair overlooking the water for an ideal work from home experience. The other living area has a sleeper sofa with memory foam mattress, ottoman and two comfortable gliding chairs. This living area also has views of the lake and is the ideal spot to curl up and read a book or play a board game. Both living areas feature TVs with streaming.

The dining area is equipped with a 6-person table as well as four stools under the kitchen counter. There is also a smaller table for two, situated in front of a window, which features lovely water views of the lake. If dining al fresco is preferred, guests can barbecue on the gas grill located on the patio, which can be eaten at the outdoor table.

Finish the evening sitting around the fire pit toasting marshmallows and reflecting on the days fun.

Make your way to the bedrooms. Whether you're staying in the master bedroom, or one of the other 4 bedrooms, the cozy ambiance and comfortable furniture will ensure a great night's sleep!

Guests have their choice of 5-bedrooms in which to retire for the night. There is a queen-sized master bedroom, with en suite bathroom with shower as well as three other queen size bedrooms, and two bedrooms with twin-sized bunk beds (one includes a third twin trundle). A queen sleeper sofa with memory foam mattress is also located in the second living room.

Looking to work from paradise? The are two desks located in the home. One in the living room overlooking the water (pictured) and one in the back bedroom with the bunk beds (pictured).

We do allow a kayak, canoe or paddle boat to be stored on the property (and used at your own risk), however do not allow any type of motorboat or jet ski for liability reasons (please do not inquire for an exception).

Unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate dog or cats as service animals due to a severe skin allergy in our family.

Guest access
The entire house, patio, lawn, beach and swim area.

Other things to note
The home is located on a shared piece of property with our primary residence. We live in the home next door and share the waterfront and swimming area, we will not get in your way but you may see us outside on occasion.

The dock can be used for walking on, sitting & swimming however cannot be used to store a boat or jet ski (please do not inquire for an exception). Same applies for the mooring, if cannot be used. No boats or jet skis allowed on the premises.

No smoking allowed on the property, inside or outside the home.

Our home next door has two external security cameras that overlook the dock and the backyard and a Nest doorbell, however they do not look into any internal spaces.

Unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate dog or cats as service animals due to a severe skin allergy in our family.

Key Residence Features:
- 5 minutes to kayak/canoe/boat rental at Fay’s Boat Yard
- Bank of NH Pavilion is 5 minutes away so book an outdoor concert with many famous acts
- Tanger Factory Outlets 20 mins away
- Amenities include a fully equipped kitchen, free Wifi, two flat-screen streaming TVs in living rooms and all 5 bedrooms, indoor gas fireplace, in-unit laundry machines, central air conditioning, parking available for up to 6 vehicles in the driveway
- Lakefront Gilford location 5-8 minutes from Gunstock Mountain Resort, Supermarket and Shopping, walk to Ellacoya Beach, short drive to Weirs Beach, Alton Bay, Meredith and Gilford Beach, and very close to many great restaurants 
- Nearest Commercial Airport: Manchester-Boston Regional Airport - 1 Airport Rd, Manchester, NH

Three level, 4 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath Lake Winnipesaukee waterfront home in Gilford. Sleeps 10.

Two miles south of Weirs Beach and Laconia. Easy ride to Meredith, Alton, or the Tilton Outlet Stores. Less than 1 mile to the Bank of New Hampshire Pavilion.

Open lake and mountain views. Sandy bottom lake, Both sides of a 47 Ft. dock for 2 boats. Large deck overlooking the lake. Hot tub at the water. AC, gas grill, cable TV, washer, dryer, dishwasher. Internet. Great waterfront. 6 car Parking .

The space
Guests will need sheets and towels when you come. There is one King, one queen, four twin size beds, and one full size pull-out sofa bed. I want to be sure everything is good for your vacation. Feel free to ask any questions you have.

Guest access
Entire house and waterfront in front of the house.

Other things to note
There is a 47 foot boat dock in front of the house and both sides are for the use of guests. The New Hampshire Liquor Store, Shaws, Hannaford, and WalMart are all close by. Many restaurants, movie theater, Funspot Arcades, Weirs Beach, are all within a 10 minute drive. Bank of new Hampshire Pavilion is 5 minutes away. Lakeport Opera House is 10 minutes away.

The water in the house is filtered lake water. We use it for everything such as showers, laundry, and even brushing our teeth. We do use water from plastic jugs for making ice and coffee.

listing_info.listing_name: Cozy Wolfeboro Getaway | Lake, Ski & Fireplace
listing_info.description:
Welcome to Lake a Dream - your cozy, family-friendly Wolfeboro getaway in EVERY season! Enjoy our neighborhood beach just a 5-minute walk away or explore charming downtown Wolfeboro, only 5 minutes from the cottage. Winter is just as magical! Ski at Wolfeboro’s hidden gem, Abenaki Ski Area, skate, snowshoe or simply cozy up by the fireplace with hot cocoa & family games. Looking for a bigger mountain day? Gunstock & King Pine are nearby too!

The space
Lake a Dream has been thoughtfully updated while keeping that cozy, lakeside New England cottage feel. With 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths & plenty of room to spread out, it’s perfect for families or friends traveling together.

The first floor features 2 bedrooms, a full bath & an open-concept kitchen, dining and living area with a cozy fireplace. Upstairs you’ll find the primary bedroom with an ensuite bath & private balcony - perfect for morning coffee.

And the kids’ favorite? Our “Fort Room!” With 4 twin beds and plenty of space to play, it gives the kids their own fun little retreat while the adults relax downstairs.

Guest access
As part of your stay, you’ll have access to our neighborhood beach just a short 3-minute walk from the cottage! Enjoy the sandy beach, grassy area & picnic tables - perfect for summer days by the lake.

Please note: While the beach is close by, it is located at the bottom of a steep hill with stairs leading down. Guests may drive down briefly to unload beach gear, but vehicles must be returned to the cottage as guest parking is not permitted at the beach.

Please be respectful of our neighbors and residents who also share this space.

The cottage has a large driveway with plenty of room for multiple vehicles and even a boat trailer.

Quiet hours at both the property and beach begin at 10 PM.

Other things to note
A few helpful details before your stay:

☕ We provide a Keurig, electric kettle, coffee, hot cocoa pods & tea - perfect for slow mornings or cozy nights by the fire!

🏖️ Our neighborhood beach is approximately 1/5 mile from the cottage (about a 5-minute walk). Please note that the walk down to the beach is downhill.

🗑️ There are no trash bins at the beach, so please bring anything you take with you back to the cottage.

♻️ Trash & recycling pickup is provided. We simply ask that all trash and recycling be placed in the designated, labeled bins outside in the shed.

listing_info.listing_name: Modern Lake Retreat | Winnipesaukee | Ski & Swim
listing_info.description:
Just steps from Glendale Marina and minutes to Lake Winnipesaukee, this fully renovated 4-bedroom home puts you close to everything—concerts, beaches, boating, and mountain adventures. Ideal for families, groups, and lake lovers looking for comfort, space, and an unbeatable location. You’re only 1.5 miles from the Bank of NH Pavilion, close enough to walk if you’re up for it and want to skip the concert traffic!

The space
Step inside and feel the energy shift. This bright, fully renovated four-bedroom home isn’t just a place to stay, it’s your basecamp for everything the Lakes Region has to offer. Mornings start with coffee and plans, ski gear by the door, lake bags ready to go, concert outfits picked out, and food spots queued up. This is where adventures begin and end.

Sleep comes easy after full days out. Three calm queen bedrooms give everyone their own space to recharge, while the fourth bedroom with four single beds becomes a fun, high-energy hangout for kids, friends, and late-night laughs. Blackout curtains, premium linens, and smart TVs make rest feel effortless.

The kitchen hums with movement and connection. Breakfast before the slopes. Snacks between lake runs. Late dinners after concerts and dockside dining. It’s built for real use, real meals, and real gathering.

Outside, the vibe keeps going. Cornhole games spark instant competition. The yard feels like your own social space to unwind, reset, and laugh it off.

With easy access to skiing, Lake Winnipesaukee, marinas, concerts, restaurants, and everything in between, this isn’t a quiet hideaway, it’s a launchpad. A place for ski crews, concert weekends, foodie trips, lake days, and memory-making from morning to night.

🐾Pets are not allowed unless approved in writing.
If approved, please note that only dogs are allowed, no cats or other pets, to ensure a comfortable stay for all guests.

Kindly let us know in advance if you’ll be bringing your dog, and be sure to include them in your reservation, as a pet fee will apply.

Guest access
You’ll have full private access to the entire home, yard, and driveway, making it easy to settle in and feel at home from the moment you arrive. Enjoy the cornhole games, and outdoor seating spaces that turn evenings into gatherings and slow moments into memories. The marina pass must be reserved in advance so everything is seamless when you arrive.

Other things to note
Glendale Marina parking pass is available for guests, but must be coordinated before arrival
No direct lake access from the yard — access is via the marina or nearby beaches.
Boat slips are not available at the property.

For paid transient slips, guests may contact Fay’s Marina directly—advance contact is recommended. Alternatively, Glendale Marina offers a convenient public boat launch with parking available while in use. Please note this is a launch-only facility, so boats must be launched and removed each time.

If you plan to use the marina, please let us know in advance so we can provide the necessary marina passes.

Located on a quiet residential street; please respect quiet hours after 10:00 pm
Exterior security cameras are present for safety only
Central A/C throughout the home
Ideal for families and groups visiting for boating, concerts, skiing, or lake time

Note:
-Glendale Marina pass is included, but must be coordinated before your arrival
-Quiet street — please respect neighborhood rules after 10pm

✅ Good News! Your stay includes coverage for accidental damage and mishaps. We take your safety and security seriously, and this property has special local compliance requirements of a signed rental agreement and ID verification. To make this easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account — it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

listing_info.listing_name: Beautiful, private, lake front, flat, sandy beach.
listing_info.description:
Each season offers relaxation & fun for everyone. Enjoy a private, sandy beach and access to clean water for swimming and lake adventures! Beach toys available (canoe, row boat, paddle boat, paddle board etc). This property contains everything you need to enjoy stress-free vacationing including all the necessities. Located close to trails for walking/snowmobiling (bring your own 4-wheelers or snowmobiles and enjoy Corridor 19 trails. Plenty of parking.

The space
The house is approximately 1750 sq.ft with two floors. There is a master bedroom with a king size bed. 2nd bedroom has a queen size bed. 3rd bedroom has bunk beds with a full-size mattress on the bottom and a trundle bed. Final bedroom is downstairs with French doors and a private entrance to beach with full size sofa bed. The bathroom downstairs has a shower, sink and washer/dryer. The bathroom upstairs has a tub/shower. There are two living spaces on each floor- both include a gorgeous electric fireplace and flatscreen TV plus comfy couches. There is a large deck with lots of seating and a grill. If you prefer shade, you can relax on the patio. The private, sandy beach includes a fire-pit and dock. The property is located on a dead-end road for maximum privacy. The water is located in a small cove with clean, fairly shallow swimming area.

Guest access
You can access all non-motorized water toys in the shed as well as cushions and umbrellas etc.

Bring the whole family to this great place on Balch Lake with lots of room for indoor and outdoor activities. It has 200 ft of private beach frontage with a boat launch for a small boat or jet ski with dock. We also have a canoe and a kayak for your use. Enjoy grilling on the deck outside overlooking the water. Enjoy fishing, waterskiing etc. Wakefield has several restaurants, 7 lakes, and is 45 minutes to North Conway with outlet shopping and more restaurants and 30 minutes to Wolfeboro.

The space
This property sits on 2.5 acres of land with a private 200 ft of water frontage. The location is perfect and easy access from the road and to local stores for all your needs from gas, groceries, laundromat and restaurants. We are the only lake in the area that has a marina that offers gas on the weekends. You can also launch a larger boat from there for a fee. Our cove on Balch Lake is quiet and our road is dead end so not many homes are on it. Balch Lake is half ME half NH so you get lots of properties on the lake that have not been touched and still look wooded. Come enjoy our property and all the serenity it has to offer.
